article.story: COLUMBIA, Mo. -- — Bryson Tiller scored 23 points and grabbed a season-high 10 rebounds to lead Missouri in a 102-41 rout over winless Alcorn State on Wednesday night. Mark Mitchell Jr. added 16 points off the bench for Missouri (4-1), which shot 58% overall, made nine dunks and outrebounded the Braves 50-29. Jason Crowe Jr. scored 14 points for the Tigers. Kennard Davis Jr. added 11 and is 13 points shy of reaching a career 1,000. The Tigers opened on a 25-2 run and led 51-18 at the break after shooting 68% from the floor. Crowe hit three 3s and scored 12 first-half points to pace the Tigers. Tiller chipped in with 10 points. Calvin Sirmans III scored 10 points for Alcorn State (0-6). The Tigers have shot at least 50% in all four of their wins this season. Missouri shot 41% in a 90-84 loss against Saint Louis. Up next Missouri: hosts Le Moyne on Friday in the second game of a five-game homestand. Alcorn State: at Louisiana Tech on Tuesday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
